title: Futuristic Atrium Climate Control Designer
description: The user designs the climate control layout for a futuristic glass atrium building. Ion drive units serve as advanced HVAC turbines mounted on structural columns, while water bottles represent coolant reservoir nodes placed along the floor plan. The user must position, rotate, and configure both asset types to achieve optimal airflow coverage across the atrium zones.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a futuristic atrium climate control designer. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: PrimaryIonDrive.glb as HVAC turbine units and WaterBottle.glb as coolant reservoir nodes. Scene setup: Create a transparent glass atrium floor plan using a 20x20 grid of semi-transparent tiles (MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission 0.3). Add four tall cylindrical columns at grid quadrant centers. Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0,15,20) with OrbitControls. Add ambient light intensity 0.6, a directional light from above, and subtle blue point lights at each column. Interactions requiring parameter validation (6-10 steps): Step 1: User clicks a column to select it as a turbine mount point, highlighted with an emissive outline. Step 2: A UI panel appears letting the user set turbine power level (1-5 slider) before confirming placement. Step 3: On confirm, clone and attach a scaled PrimaryIonDrive model to the selected column top, with rotation animation speed proportional to power level. Step 4: User clicks any floor tile to place a coolant reservoir. Step 5: A panel requests coolant capacity input (100-500 liters, validated as integer in range). Step 6: On confirm, clone and place a WaterBottle at that tile, scaled by capacity value (scale 0.5 to 2.0 mapped from capacity range). Step 7: After placing at least 2 turbines and 2 reservoirs, an Analyze button activates. Step 8: Clicking Analyze draws animated particle streams (blue points) from each turbine to nearest reservoir, visualizing airflow paths using BufferGeometry lines with dash animation. Validate that every turbine has a reservoir within 8 grid units or show a warning. Display a coverage score percentage in an overlay HUD based on how many grid quadrants have both a turbine and reservoir. Use dat.gui or simple HTML overlay panels for all UI. All models should cast and receive shadows with a soft shadow map.
